assertions.name: control_an_underived_candidate_does_clear
assertions.source: interface-candidate-screen I5 = (s3 s2 s4 s3)^2, traced here and carried forward as the contrast; it clears the magnitude bar (> 1) and has no derivation

description: Derives an interface from the colour-tube structure FIRST -- 9 colour-pair couplings realised as the 9-crossing block transposition -- then measures it. It CLEARS the structural bar (not provably a connected sum) and FAILS the magnitude bar at 0.4217x, tracing BELOW the single crossing it replaces. Addendum 29's I5 clears magnitude at 1.2475x with no derivation. So the interface with a reason does not work and the interface that works has no reason; no rescue is attempted.
caveats: THE 9-CROSSING READING IS MINE, NOT THE BLOCK'S. conj:inter-nucleon-channel-color-tube explicitly specifies a weighted sum over ONE generator. What is proposed is a different realisation of the same geometric input -- nine couplings as nine crossings rather than nine weights on one crossing. The block does not say this.

RULES OUT (scope (a)): the colour-pair block transposition as a route to the binding magnitude at the deuteron. DOES NOT rule out: the colour-tube structure itself, which may be right about p/n asymmetry and chirality signs while saying nothing about magnitude; a different braid realisation of the same nine couplings (the permutation braid is the minimal positive one, not the only one); or an interface derived from elsewhere.

Does NOT establish an essential torus. 'Not provably a connected sum' is necessary, not sufficient; incompressibility is geometric and no probe here tests it. float64 traces via block_rep_braid_word; the gaps here are tens of percent.
